title: Duubatti Deebi'uu Kophaa
intro: Seenaa tola waaqayyoo keessatti lubbuun qulqullummaa gita hin qabne, kallattii qulqulluutti kophummaa barbaaduuf saba isaanii irraa adda baafame jira. Kophaa ta’uun kun addunyaa hundumaaf mallattoo, qormaata amantii bara baraan dubbatamu akka fidu hin beekan turan.
clues: Dhaloota koo dura jireenya tajaajilaaf of kenneera.
Rabbiin irraa rizqii eegduu kiyya ajaa’ibsiiseen jiraachise.
Maatii koo irraa gara bakka bahaatti of baase.
Ergamaan tokko bifa nama mudaa hin qabneen oduu ilma qulqulluu fidee natti mul’ate.
Yeroon daa'ima koo reefuu wajjin deebi'u sabni koo na himate, garuu daa'imni sun naaf falmuuf dubbate.

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Daa'imni tokko haadha tokko ittisuuf dubbatte
Ibiddi qabbanaa'ee fi nageenya qabu ta'e
Qurxummiin galaanaa kun qarqara galaanaa irratti garaa kaasaa ture
outcome.answer: Daa'imni tokko haadha tokko ittisuuf dubbatte

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ فِى ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَرْيَمَ إِذِ ٱنتَبَذَتْ مِنْ أَهْلِهَا مَكَانًۭا شَرْقِيًّۭا
verse: And mention, [O Muḥammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east. (19:16)
